Name: Farm Plan Overlay
Author: SsparrowsS
Description:
Have you ever designed an intricate Stardew Valley farm on the Stardew Farm Planner, and realised that you have no idea how you will actually build it on your actual farm in Stardew?

Well, the Farm Plan Overlay mod solves this very niche problem of yours! It allows you to see your pre-designed farm plan as a semi-transparent image over your farm that can be toggled on and off by pressing f1. This lets you build your farm exactly how you designed it on the plan, to scale in-game, as it locks onto the farm grid without obstructing the player.

*IMPORTANT*
you must add your farm plan (as a png) into the assets folder in the mod folders in order for the mod to work. <3

Also, when viewing your farm plan, make sure that your zoom level in-game is at 100% (what it is originally set to) for the mod to function properly.
